QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is on and the compiler is GCC-style (`__GNUC__`) or ARMCC (`library/constant_time_impl.h:40-52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros (`__GNUC__`/ARMCC) inside constant_time_impl.h. That means it is derived, not set in a config file.
